title: Dairy Farmer / Entrepreneur
text: Rearing cattle and buffaloes, scientific feed & fodder management, hygienic milking practices, animal health basics, disease prevention, value addition (curd, ghee, paneer, khoa), milk chilling & storage, cooperative marketing and micro-enterprise setup. Suits individuals and smallholders rearing cows or buffaloes and selling milk in rural/semi-urban areas.
modules: Value Added Dairy Products (Ghee, Paneer, Curd)
career_path: Dairy Worker -> Commercial Dairy Farmer -> Milk Collection Center Operator -> Dairy Cooperative Entrepreneur
pm_ajay_grant: Eligible for 100% free NSQF skilling + ₹15,000 tool kit subsidy + GIA capital subsidy for dairy shed & equipment

title: Organic Grower / Farmer
text: Planning and practicing organic crop cultivation, soil health management, on-farm organic inputs (Jeevamrut, Panchagavya, vermicompost, bio-fertilizers), biological pest and weed management, organic certification standards (NPOP/PGS-India), harvesting, post-harvest handling, and organic produce marketing. Suits traditional farmers and kitchen-garden cultivators.
career_path: Subsistence Farmer -> Certified Organic Grower -> Organic Cluster Leader -> Organic Agribusiness Supplier
pm_ajay_grant: Eligible for 100% funded training + organic input kit grant under PM-AJAY GIA

title: Micro Irrigation Technician
text: Installation, testing, operation, troubleshooting and maintenance of drip and sprinkler irrigation systems in agricultural fields. Handling pipes, PVC fittings, drippers, filters, venturi fertilizer injectors, pumps, and water pressure gauges. Suits individuals working with farm water management, borewells, and plumbing.
modules: PVC Pipe Fitting, Solvent Welding & Laying
career_path: Field Assistant -> Micro Irrigation Technician -> Service Center Supervisor -> Irrigation Contractor
pm_ajay_grant: Fully funded NSQF certification + tool kit support under GIA component

title: Poultry Farm Worker / Manager
text: Broiler and layer management, desi poultry rearing (Kadaknath, Aseel), shed hygiene and biosecurity, feeder and drinker maintenance, poultry vaccination, egg collection and grading, bird nutrition, and local broiler/egg marketing. Suits rural households keeping backyard chickens or small poultry sheds.
career_path: Poultry Attendant -> Commercial Farm Supervisor -> Independent Poultry Entrepreneur
pm_ajay_grant: 100% subsidized skilling + bird rearing startup subsidy under PM-AJAY

title: Goat & Sheep Farmer
text: Goat and sheep rearing, breed selection (Jamunapari, Sirohi, Black Bengal), stall-feeding vs grazing management, shelter construction, kid care, vaccination and deworming, fodder cultivation, and meat/live animal trade. Ideal for rural landless laborers and smallholders in SC communities.
career_path: Grazer / Shepherd -> Commercial Goat Farm Operator -> Breeding Unit Entrepreneur
pm_ajay_grant: PM-AJAY GIA grant for goat shelter and livestock asset purchase

title: Aquaculture / Fishery Pond Technician
text: Pond preparation, water quality parameters testing (pH, dissolved oxygen), seed stocking (Rohu, Catla, Mrigal, Tilapia), supplementary feeding, disease management, netting, harvesting, cold storage, and market supply. Suits fish rearers and pond leaseholders.
career_path: Pond Laborer -> Fish Farm Supervisor -> Aquaculture Entrepreneur
pm_ajay_grant: Full training funding + fishery input grant under PM-AJAY GIA

title: Stitching Machine Operator (Tailoring)
text: Single needle lockstitch machine operation, cutting fabric using patterns, stitching blouses, kurtas, shirts, trousers, hems, seams, attachments, ironing, quality checks, machine oiling and needle replacement. Suits persons who stitch garments at home, mend clothes, or work in local tailor shops.
career_path: Sewing Operator -> Senior Tailor -> Sample Maker -> Tailoring Shop Owner / Unit Leader
pm_ajay_grant: 100% free NSQF training + ₹15,000 PM-AJAY motorized sewing machine tool kit grant

title: Self Employed Tailor / Boutique Entrepreneur
text: Custom measurement taking, drafting custom master patterns, cutting designer garments, specialized ladies and gents tailoring (salwar suits, designer blouses, shirts, uniforms), pricing orders, purchasing raw fabrics, managing customer relationships, and managing a tailoring shop. Suits independent tailors wanting to scale.
modules: Advanced Body Measurement & Master Pattern Drafting
career_path: Home Tailor -> Master Tailor -> Boutique Owner -> Apparel Producer Group Lead
pm_ajay_grant: Certified qualification + GIA capital subsidy for boutique shop setup

title: Hand Embroiderer / Aari Zari Artisan
text: Frame mounting (Adda), transfer of tracing designs on fabric, aari needle work, zardozi, sequins, bead work, bullion knots, mirror work, and finishing bridal and ethnic garments. Suits traditional artisans and home-based women workers doing needlecraft.
modules: Direct Artisan Market & Fashion House Linkages
career_path: Embroiderer -> Master Artisan -> Adda Production Supervisor -> Craft Guild Leader
pm_ajay_grant: NSQF certification + ₹10,000 artisan tool kit and exhibition subsidy

title: Electrician - Domestic Solutions
min_education: 8th Class passed / ITI / Prior Electrical Experience
text: Domestic electrical wiring, installing single-phase and three-phase distribution boards, MCB and RCCB installation, earthing, lighting and fan fixtures, repairing domestic appliances (irons, mixers, immersion rods, ceiling fans), testing with multimeter and voltage tester. Suits informal electricians and appliance repairers.
modules: Safety Protocols, Earthing & Indian Electricity Rules
Conduit Wiring, Distribution Boards & Circuit Protection
career_path: Electrician Helper -> Domestic Electrician -> Licensed Electrical Contractor -> Building MEP Supervisor
pm_ajay_grant: 100% free certification + standard safety electrical tool kit under PM-AJAY GIA

title: Solar Panel Installation & Maintenance Technician (Surya Mitra)
min_education: 10th Class passed or 8th with electrical experience
text: Site assessment, mounting solar PV panels on rooftops and open grounds, electrical cabling and inverter connection, battery bank integration, solar pump installation, net-metering basics, cleaning and routine maintenance, and fault diagnosis. High growth sector aligned with PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana.
modules: Mechanical Mounting, Pitch Alignment & Civil Anchoring
career_path: Solar Installer -> Surya Mitra Solar Technician -> Solar Project Site In-Charge -> Solar Enterprise Contractor
pm_ajay_grant: Full training scholarship + PM-AJAY green skill incentive toolkit

title: Mobile Phone Hardware Repair Technician
text: Disassembly and assembly of smartphones, display screen / touch digitizer replacement, battery replacement, charging port and microphone soldering using hot air gun and micro-soldering station, PCB track diagnostics, water damage treatment, flashing and software recovery. Suits mobile shop assistants and hobbyist repairers.
modules: Multimeter Diagnostics for Short Circuit & Power IC
Mobile Repair Shop Management & Parts Sourcing
career_path: Repair Apprentice -> Mobile Technician -> Service Center Lab Engineer -> Repair Shop Owner
pm_ajay_grant: NSQF Certificate + precision soldering toolkit subsidy under PM-AJAY GIA

title: Food Processing & Preservation Assistant
text: Handling fruits, vegetables, grains, spices, making pickles, jams, squashes, dehydrated snacks, papads, chips, hygienic processing, FSSAI hygiene standards, weighing, batch cooking, preservative dosage, sterile jar bottling, vacuum pouch sealing, and expiry labeling. Suits rural self-help group members cooking and processing foods.
career_path: Food Production Helper -> Food Processing Technician -> Quality Supervisor -> Micro Food Enterprise Owner
pm_ajay_grant: 100% free training + FSSAI registration guidance + food processing equipment grant

title: Baking & Confectionery Technician
text: Weighing ingredients, kneading dough, operating commercial deck ovens, mixers, proofing chambers, baking breads, pav, rusks, biscuits, cakes, cookies, muffins, cooling, slicing, packaging and inventory management. Suits bakery workers and home bakers.
modules: Ingredient Science, Yeast Action & Recipe Formulation
career_path: Bakery Assistant -> Master Baker -> Bakery Production Supervisor -> Bakery Shop Entrepreneur
pm_ajay_grant: PM-AJAY GIA skilling support + bakery start-up tool kit

title: Two-Wheeler Service & Repair Technician
text: Periodic servicing of motorcycles and scooters, engine oil change, spark plug cleaning, carburetor tuning, electronic fuel injection (EFI) diagnostic scanning, drum and disc brake overhaul, suspension servicing, clutch cable and chain sprocket replacement, electrical wiring and battery health check. Suits roadside two-wheeler mechanics.
modules: Electrical Starter, Magneto, Lighting & Battery Servicing
Garage Setup, Customer Invoicing & PM-AJAY Funding
career_path: Mechanic Helper -> Two-Wheeler Technician -> Service Center Head -> Auto Garage Owner
pm_ajay_grant: Free NSQF certification + ₹15,000 mechanic toolkit subsidy under PM-AJAY GIA

title: Auto Electrician & EV Battery Technician
text: Vehicle electrical system diagnosis, starter motor and alternator repair, automotive wiring harness repair, headlight relay installation, horn and indicator circuits, electric rickshaw and electric 2-wheeler motor controller wiring, lithium-ion / lead-acid battery testing and charging. High demand in rural and urban transport hubs.
modules: Starter Motor & Alternator Disassembly & Bench Testing
Battery Testing, Cell Balancing & Charger Repair
career_path: Auto Electrical Assistant -> Auto Electrician -> EV Service Specialist -> EV Workshop Owner
pm_ajay_grant: Full training scholarship + multimeters and crimping toolkit under PM-AJAY

title: Plumber (General)
text: Laying water supply pipelines (CPVC, UPVC, GI), drain and sewer piping (SWR), fixing bathroom fixtures (taps, mixers, showers, sanitaryware, water closets, washbasins), installing overhead water tanks, submersible pump connection, leak detection and repair, pressure testing. Suits informal plumbers and construction helpers.
modules: Pipe Cutting, Threading, Solvent Bonding & Jointing
Water Supply Layout & Overhead Tank Connections
Pump & Valve Installation, Leak Detection & Repair
career_path: Plumber Helper -> Certified General Plumber -> Plumbing Contractor -> MEP Plumbing Supervisor
pm_ajay_grant: 100% free NSQF certification + professional plumbing toolkit grant under PM-AJAY GIA

title: General Mason / Rural Construction Specialist
text: Brick and stone masonry, mortar mixing, laying foundations, wall alignment using plumb bob and spirit level, plastering walls and ceilings, laying cement flooring and tiles, setting door and window frames, curing of concrete, bar bending basics, and rural toilet/housing construction under PMAY. Suits construction laborers seeking master mason status.
modules: Plumb, Level & Right Angle Precision Alignment
RCC Curing, Bar Bending & Foundation Laying
PMAY Rural Housing & Toilet Construction Standards
career_path: Construction Laborer -> Mason Assistant -> Head Mason (Mistri) -> Building Contractor
pm_ajay_grant: NSQF Certificate + Masonry trowel, level & safety gear toolkit under PM-AJAY

title: General Duty Assistant (GDA / Nursing Aide)
min_education: 10th Class passed or 8th with healthcare experience
text: Patient bedside care in hospitals and clinics, monitoring vital signs (temperature, pulse, BP, SpO2), patient hygiene, mobility and transfer assistance, administering prescribed oral medications under nursing supervision, sterilization of medical equipment, bio-medical waste segregation, and emergency first aid. High employment demand in government and private healthcare.
modules: Basic Human Anatomy & Vital Signs Monitoring
Patient Mobility, Bed Making & Personal Hygiene Care
First Aid, CPR & Emergency Response Basics
career_path: GDA Trainee -> Senior Nursing Assistant -> Hospital Floor Coordinator -> Nursing Staff
pm_ajay_grant: Full training fee waiver + uniform and medical kit stipend under PM-AJAY GIA

title: Home Health Aide / Elder Care Companion
text: Providing compassionate home-based care to senior citizens, bedridden patients, and persons with disabilities. Assistance with daily living activities (bathing, feeding, grooming), vital sign recording, medication reminders, fall prevention, wheelchair transfer, light diet preparation, and emotional companionship.
modules: Home Care Agency Linkages & Duty Ethics
career_path: Home Caregiver -> Senior Care Companion -> Care Coordinator -> Agency Supervisor
pm_ajay_grant: 100% free NSQF skilling + caregiver starter kit under PM-AJAY

title: Retail Sales Associate & Kirana Digital Store Assistant
min_education: 10th Class passed or 8th with shopkeeping experience
text: Greeting customers, understanding customer requirements, product display and visual merchandising, operating Point of Sale (POS) billing machines, UPI / digital payments handling, stock checking, FIFO inventory management, handling customer grievances, and managing local home deliveries. Suits shop assistants, kirana store workers, and stall operators.
modules: Product Categorization, Shelf Display & Visual Merchandising
POS Machine Billing, Cash Handling & UPI Reconciliations
Stock Inventory Counting & Expiry Date Management
E-Commerce / ONDC Onboarding for Local Kiranas
career_path: Sales Associate -> Department In-Charge -> Retail Store Manager -> Retail Franchise Owner
pm_ajay_grant: Free NSQF certification + digital POS literacy certification under PM-AJAY

title: Bamboo & Cane Craft Artisan
text: Harvesting and selecting mature bamboo culms, split-making, shaving, seasoning and anti-borer chemical/natural treatment, weaving utility baskets, furniture, lampshades, decorative artifacts, mats, and sustainable packaging. Ideal for traditional rural artisan communities.
modules: Bamboo Species Selection, Slicing & Fiber Preparation
career_path: Artisan -> Master Craftsman -> Design Studio Assistant -> Artisan Enterprise Head
pm_ajay_grant: 100% funded training + artisan tool kit and exhibition grant under PM-AJAY GIA

title: PM-AJAY GIA Beneficiary Eligibility Framework
text: Under the Grants-in-Aid (GIA) component of Pradhan Mantri Anusuchit Jaati Abhyuday Yojana (PM-AJAY), beneficiaries must belong to Scheduled Caste (SC) communities. Priority is given to rural landless laborers, traditional artisans, smallholders, women, and youth aged 18 to 45 years. Annual household income should conform to state BPL/priority thresholds or up to ₹2.5 Lakhs. 100% of training cost is covered by the Central Government with zero out-of-pocket cost to the citizen.
eligibility_checklist: Possesses valid Aadhaar / Voter ID and Bank Account linked to Aadhaar

title: PM-AJAY Skilling Grants, Tool Kit & Stipend Policy
text: Under PM-AJAY GIA Skill Development: (1) Free residential or non-residential NSQF-aligned training through NSDC / Sector Skill Council certified training partners. (2) Daily conveyance / boarding allowance during training period. (3) Post-training Tool-Kit assistance up to ₹15,000 for self-employment trades (Tailoring, Electrical, Plumbing, Masonry, Mechanics, Artisans). (4) Post-placement tracking for 12 months with continuous voice mentoring.
eligibility_checklist: Assessment and certification by NCVET / SSC
Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) of stipend to Aadhaar linked bank account

title: Income Generation Project (IGP) Capital Linkage
text: Graduates of NSQF Level 3-4 programs under PM-AJAY GIA are eligible for forward linkage into PM-AJAY Income Generation Projects (IGP) providing up to ₹50,000 or 50% subsidy for micro-enterprise assets (dairy cattle, sewing machines, mobile repair lab, plumbing tools, organic farm inputs), combined with bank loans under Mudra / Stand Up India schemes.
eligibility_checklist: Viable micro-business plan prepared with Guidance Agent
Recommendation approval by State Skilling Officer
